summary: Publishes its position globally so every grass-shaded renderer bends away, with no per-patch wiring.
overview: Drop it on a character walking through grass. It publishes its position into a GLOBAL array that every grass-shaded renderer reads, so any number of grass patches react with zero wiring per patch — a deliberate divergence from the ripple emitter, which drives its own material's block instead.
useCases: A character parting grass as they walk.
Many grass patches reacting without connecting each one.

params.tuning: How far the influence reaches. Too large and a whole field leans at once, which reads as wind rather than footsteps.
The push on a blade standing right at the object. Extreme values lay grass flat and look broken.

gotchas.title: A fixed-size global array caps the emitters
gotchas.body: Beyond the limit, extra emitters are dropped. Put it on the player and a few key creatures, not on everything.
